All 31 SKILL.md files in the a–i range have been read in full. Report follows.

# Audit Report: skills/ a–i (31 SKILL.md files, ~7,700 lines)

Base directory: `/Users/davidohara/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-Improving/IES/skills/` (all paths below are relative to it unless absolute).

## A. Systemic cross-file boilerplate (category 3, affects nearly the whole set)

**A1. "SKILL COMPLETE" signal-file section — near-verbatim in 30 of 31 files.** Every file except `eval-signal-write` carries a ~20–28 line block hand-typing the same JSON shape plus the same trigger/status rules ("Set `trigger` to `"boot"` if called from a boot workflow..."). This directly contradicts `eval-signal-write/SKILL.md` line 17, which says it "exists so the JSON shape isn't hand-typed and re-typed in every skill's SKILL COMPLETE section." Disposition: RELOCATE — replace each block with a 3–4 line call to `skills/eval-signal-write/SKILL.md` (bookings-review and co-sell-pipeline already show the correct short form at their lines 127–138 and 231–243). ~660 removable lines across the set.

**A2. "GRADE THIS RUN" section — near-verbatim in all 31 files (~13 lines each).** Identical prose except the skill name; in `eval-signal-write` it is even self-contradictory ("Immediately after writing the skill-run signal file above" — that skill writes none, per its own lines 68–71). Disposition: RELOCATE — centralize once (e.g., a short shared reference or the eval-signal-write skill) and keep one line per skill. ~403 removable lines.

**A3. "Plan-Only Mode" section — near-verbatim in 8 files** (`account-targeting`, `campaign-response-log`, `campaign-send`, `campaign-setup`, `contact-targeting`, `calendar-handler`, `delivery-router`, `episode-transcript-intake`), ~9 lines each. Same skeleton, one skill-specific sentence each. Compressible to 1–2 lines + pointer. ~70 removable lines.

**A4. "Eval-harness exception" paragraph (4 lines)** duplicated verbatim in the 8 Podcast-to-Pipeline skills. ~32 lines.

## B. Per-file findings (worst first)

### 1. galen-protocols/SKILL.md — ~100 removable lines (largest offender)
- **Lines 38–138, RUN-LOG RESIDUE.** Excerpt: "**Inventory as of June 14, 2026 (at revised doses)**". The file hardcodes the entire current stack protocol ("ACTIVE as of Jun 29, 2026"), a dated inventory table, the "Tesamorelin Dose — FINALIZED (2026-06-14, Galen bloodwork review)" decision narrative (lines 103–111), the June 2026 bloodwork-flags table (113–127), and an "Upcoming Actions" run log with COMPLETE/ACTIVE statuses (129–138). This directly violates the file's own rules at lines 28 and 36: "Do not maintain a duplicate here... Do not hardcode peptide status in this skill. Always read from tracking.json."
- Disposition: RELOCATE. Current-state data (stack, dosing, inventory, rest windows, bloodwork flags) → `data/health/tracking.json` + `data/health/metrics-log.json` (both already exist as the declared authoritative homes). Decision narratives with ongoing clinical reference value (Tesamorelin rationale lines 105–111, Semax mechanism/evidence lines 67–84) → `memory/semantic/domain-knowledge/` or a `data/health/` protocol-spec file. Then DELETE from SKILL.md, keeping only the read-from-data instructions.

### 2. dream-cycle/SKILL.md — ~48 removable lines
- **Lines 16–45, REDUNDANT BOILERPLATE (cross-file, and now contradictory).** Excerpt: "**ALWAYS** prefix git write commands with `rm -f .git/index.lock &&`". This ~30-line git rule set duplicates `skills/git/SKILL.md` (lines 74–112) and *contradicts* it: dream-cycle instructs chaining add+commit in one call and `git status --short`, while the git skill's Atomic Command Rule forbids chaining and the mechanically-enforced git-gate (git/SKILL.md lines 41–42) now blocks compound git writes outright — so these instructions are dead code that will be refused at runtime.
- Disposition: DELETE, replace with a one-line pointer: "All git operations follow `skills/git/SKILL.md` — Desktop Commander for remote ops, atomic single commands."
- **Lines 254–276, REDUNDANT BOILERPLATE (within-file).** Excerpt: "After writing the signal file, also write a working memory file". Duplicates Phase 5's final-action instruction at lines 187–190 (write `dream-summary-{date}.md` to `memory/working/`). ~23 lines, DELETE the appended block.

### 3. co-sell-pipeline/SKILL.md — ~38 removable lines
- **Lines 229–266 vs 269–293, REDUNDANT BOILERPLATE (within-file).** Excerpt: "## SKILL COMPLETE... call `skills/eval-signal-write/SKILL.md`". Two complete and competing completion sections: the older eval-signal-write + working-memory version, then the newer skill-runs-JSON version (with a stale `"agent": "co"` value). DELETE one entire set (~38 lines).

### 4. bookings-review/SKILL.md — ~37 removable lines
- **Lines 125–161 vs 164–188, REDUNDANT BOILERPLATE (within-file).** Excerpt: "call `skills/eval-signal-write/SKILL.md` with: skill_name: `bookings-review`". Identical double-completion pattern to co-sell-pipeline; the newer block carries a buggy `"agent": "bookings"`. DELETE one entire set (~37 lines).

### 5. galen-visit-prep/SKILL.md — ~35 removable lines
- **Lines 221–398 (esp. 261–298, 345–370), RUN-LOG RESIDUE.** Excerpt: "ApoB elevated (80) — up 11% from August". The Step 8 brief template is populated with a past run's real data (ApoB 72→80, E2 45 "+29% from August", "DHEA dosing (started 50mg daily in August)", "Week 4 of 8") instead of placeholders. Disposition: DELETE the concrete values from the template (placeholder-ize), RELOCATE the real historical values to `data/health/metrics-log.json` (already the authoritative trend source per this file's own Step 1b). Also Step 5's goals (210 lbs / 17% / BMI <20, lines 149–152) are personal state in a system block — RELOCATE to a `data/health/` goals file.

### 6. galen-bloodwork/SKILL.md — ~35 removable lines
- **Lines 145–158, 209–222, 249–306, RUN-LOG RESIDUE.** Excerpt: "prior_value: 72 (2025-08-12) current_value: 80 (2026-03-29)". Real dated patient data embedded as "examples" in the Step 4 trend output, Step 7 question list, and Step 8 brief template — the same past run that seeded galen-visit-prep. The file's own DATA INTEGRITY RULE (line 22) shows the authors know these are hazardous format examples. Disposition: DELETE/placeholder-ize; RELOCATE real values to `data/health/metrics-log.json`.
- **Line 29, minor:** "**Latest known:** `2025/2025-12-05.pdf`" — stale dated pointer; the "list and sort" instruction at line 30 already covers it. DELETE (1 line).

### 7. chase-call-prep/SKILL.md — ~15 removable lines
- **Lines 8–24, NARRATIVE RATIONALE + RUN-LOG RESIDUE (retired-file retirement backstory).** Excerpt: "Reasons for consolidation: Two capabilities existed for the same job...". Includes an err-ID citation (line 16, "err-20260720T144623-LSBA9A") and a where-the-pieces-went migration map. Disposition: DELETE from the file (reduce to the redirect stub: status, successor path, "stop and read the workflow"); RELOCATE the consolidation rationale and piece-migration map to `memory/episodic/` — it has ongoing reference value for anyone hunting a lost section.

### 8. boot-context-analyzer/SKILL.md — ~11 removable lines
- **Lines 186–189, RUN-LOG RESIDUE.** Excerpt: "Result: calendar field now 60 KB (70% reduction) ✓". A past optimization run's result recorded inside the "Example" block. DELETE the Result line.
- **Lines 217–224, NARRATIVE RATIONALE / one-time project plan.** Excerpt: "Share the Phase 2 measurement output with the team". "Next Steps" is a completed project's to-do list ("Create optimization tasks for each source"), not standing instruction. DELETE the section (8 lines); if any item still matters, RELOCATE to `memory/working/`.

### 9. campaign-response-log/SKILL.md — ~7 removable lines
- **Lines 20–31, NARRATIVE RATIONALE (mild).** Excerpt: "it is not automating something Dynamics already does". Six lines of defensive why-the-skill-exists prose plus a documentation-police instruction ("Do not describe this skill's output as 'automatic reply detection' in any future documentation"). The one-line imperative ("Log inbound replies Dynamics does not auto-link; opens/clicks/bounces are out of scope") carries it. DELETE/condense.

### 10. chase-card-offers-chase/SKILL.md — ~5 removable lines
- **Line 126, RUN-LOG RESIDUE.** Excerpt: "A prior session accidentally added Starlink (err-20260404-002)". Incident citation; the verify-before-click rule stands without it. DELETE the err reference.
- **Lines 179–184, REDUNDANT BOILERPLATE (within-file).** "Known Issue — DOM Intercept" restates Step 4's CRITICAL warning (lines 125–132). DELETE the section; keep its one mitigation sentence ("Scroll to the target tile before clicking") merged into Step 4.

### 11. amazing-race-monitor/SKILL.md — ~4 removable lines
- **Lines 34–35, RUN-LOG RESIDUE.** Excerpt: "See error entries err-20260930T145444-71UE48 and err-20260930T150508-3FHQ8N". DELETE the err citations; keep "invented venue claims are a logged failure mode" if desired as one clause.
- **Lines 120–121, RUN-LOG RESIDUE.** Excerpt: "discovered in rehearsal, a fork died on its first image Read". DELETE the incident sentence; keep the rule (use a sonnet sub-agent, not a fork — image inputs).

### 12. campaign-setup/SKILL.md — ~4 removable lines
- **Lines 24–27, RUN-LOG RESIDUE (one-off tenant audit note).** Excerpt: "alongside 5 existing dormant journeys from other employees' past experiments (2022–2025...)". Build-time verification detail in the Purpose section. The dedup targets themselves (named at lines 57–63) have ongoing value — RELOCATE the dormant-journey name list to a `data/` or CRM-notes file; DELETE the audit narrative from Purpose.

### 13. git/SKILL.md — ~9 removable lines (rules stay, incident archaeology goes)
- **Lines 39, 44, 45, RUN-LOG RESIDUE.** Excerpts: "as of 2026-10-08 (coordinator purity, Stage 5 remediation)"; "(err-20261008T225136-RWH7B6 hardening, 2026-10-09)"; "`updatedInput` empirical note (2026-10-08, verified live both ways)". DELETE the dated remediation/error-ID tags. The `updatedInput` mechanics (line 45) have ongoing value — keep the rule, DELETE the verification transcript ("verified live both ways") or RELOCATE to `memory/working/`.
- **Lines 82, 86, RUN-LOG RESIDUE.** Excerpts: "recurring blockers since 2026-06-16"; "This caused the 2026-06-13 → 2026-06-22 recurring lock blocker pattern visible in `memory/dream.log`". DELETE the historical narrative sentences (~5 lines); the prohibitions themselves are load-bearing and stay.
- **Line 120, RUN-LOG RESIDUE.** Excerpt: "recurred three times (err-20260829T161002-X7JBHO and prior)". DELETE the citation, keep the rule.

### 14. Smaller items (1–3 lines each)
- **campaign-send/SKILL.md lines 59, 113** — "per the CBRE unmerged-account lesson/pattern" err-citations. DELETE the tags, keep the rules. (~2 lines)
- **account-targeting/SKILL.md line 70** — "(the CBRE-session failure mode)". DELETE tag. (~1 line)
- **chase-card-offers-discover/SKILL.md line 182** — "**Current Q2 2026:** ... ACTIVATED as of 2026-04-01." Dated run record in body; stale by now (Q4 2026). RELOCATE activation status to `systems/credit-cards/benefits-tracker.json` (the file this skill already updates), DELETE here. (~1 line)
- **harper-blog-linkedin-post/SKILL.md lines 115–117** — "Grammarly is a required connector. If unavailable, request elevation..." stated twice within Step 4a. DELETE the second statement. (~2 lines)
- **harper-podcast-review/SKILL.md line 25** — "Season 1: 7 episodes (complete). Season 2: in progress." Dated state; the prior-review files at line 26 are the real source. DELETE. (~1 line)
- **invintory/SKILL.md line 267** — "wine locker: 10400 Clarence Dr, Frisco TX" is personal data embedded in a system-block usage example; RELOCATE to a data/ config if the locker address matters operationally. (~1 line)

### Clean files (file-specific findings only)
`add-reminder`, `audience-profile-builder`, `calendar-handler`, `chase-card-offers-amex`, `chase-card-offers-citi`, `contact-targeting`, `delivery-router`, `episode-transcript-intake`, `galen-morning-snapshot`, `galen-whoop-analysis`, `grammarly-polish`, `eval-signal-write` (apart from the boilerplate items A1/A2). Voice/framing content (harper skills, galen coaching themes) was treated as deliberate identity design and not flagged, per scope.

## C. Personal blocks — FLAG-ONLY (no edit proposed)

- `amazing-race-monitor/SKILL.md` lines 333–342: 9 lines of real instance config (IES root path, 2026 event identity, rules-doc path, Slack IDs `U0ANHV5UXEW`/`C0AN2PQNXBR`, channel-identity note). Has ongoing operational value; flagged only.
- `git/SKILL.md` lines 50–54: "Jurisdiction" — this reads as system-scope content living inside a personal block (likely misplaced during a block-restructuring pass); flagged only.
- Empty personal blocks (2 lines each, zero content — trivially removable but flagged only per rule): `add-reminder` 233–234; `calendar-handler` 46–47, 245–246, 288–289; `delivery-router` 41–42, 147–148, 190–191; `eval-signal-write` 20–21, 64–65, 87–88; `harper-podcast-review` 211–212; `invintory` 32–33, 376–377.

## E. Totals

- **File-specific removable: ~360 lines** across 18 files.
- **Systemic cross-file boilerplate (removable if centralized per A1–A4): ~1,165 lines** across the set (A1 ~660, A2 ~403, A3 ~70, A4 ~32).
- **Grand total: ~1,525 of ~7,700 lines (~20%)** of the a–i SKILL.md corpus is removable or centralizable without losing any standing instruction. File-specific items alone are ~5%.

## F. Systemic patterns — how the commentary got there

The dominant mechanism is **eval-harness rollout appending standardized completion sections onto every SKILL.md mechanically**: the "GRADE THIS RUN" block was stamped on all 31 files (including nonsensically onto `eval-signal-write`), and where a file already had the older `eval-signal-write`-based completion instructions, the new `skill-runs/*.json` block was appended *without removing the old one* — leaving bookings-review, co-sell-pipeline, dream-cycle, and invintory with two contradictory completion sections (and stale agent values like `"bookings"` and `"co"`). The second mechanism is **real-run output pasted back as templates**: the galen skills were built from an actual analysis session (dated ApoB/E2 values recur verbatim across galen-bloodwork and galen-visit-prep), and galen-protocols pasted then-current stack/inventory/bloodwork state dated 2026-06-14 directly under its own "do not hardcode, read tracking.json" rule — state that rots silently. Third, **error-log archaeology as inline justification**: the "we saw X (err-YYYY...) so now..." pattern (amazing-race-monitor, git, chase-card-offers-chase, chase-call-prep, campaign-send, account-targeting) shows rigby-error-analysis fixes writing incident citations back into instruction files where only the resulting rule belongs. Finally, **git learnings forked before enforcement**: dream-cycle carries a pre-git-gate git rule set that now contradicts the mechanically enforced git skill and will be blocked at runtime — a cleanup pass should treat any cross-file git guidance outside `skills/git/SKILL.md` as dead.
